content: We need to determine number of carbonyl groups in the sample's compound. We have no SMILES given. We have tools to get spectra: carbon_nmr_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra, hsqc_nmr_spectra, ir_spectra. Carbonyl groups show characteristic IR around 1700 cm-1. Also carbonyl carbon in 13C NMR around 190-210 ppm. Could retrieve carbon shifts ranges. But we need to know the sample's compound; we don't have its identity. We need to get IR spectra and look for carbonyl peak. Use ir_spectra tool.
